방향: Front is one square wall with visible finger joints; right side is adjacent wall.

방향: Front looks between the two ceramic lugs, lugs at left and right; right side looks directly at one lug.

대상: one traditional woodworking wooden mallet, chunky rectangular cedar head with thick chamfered corners and a short straight central wooden handle, no metal
방향: Handle points vertically downward in all views. Front sees the long broad face of the mallet head; right side sees the short striking end.

대상: one shallow rectangular wooden seedling nursery tray with six empty chunky compartments in a two by three grid, thick rim and low stout feet, no plants or soil
방향: Front is the long side with three compartments behind it; right side is short end with two compartments.

방향: Stand upright: handle up, rake head below. Front sees all five teeth spread left to right, right side sees narrow end of rake head with teeth overlapping.

대상: one round rustic golden brown bread loaf with exactly three wide shallow parallel scoring cuts across the domed top, broad faceted stylized crust, no plate or crumbs
방향: Bread rests flat. Front sees the loaf side, scoring lines run toward camera; right side rotated 90 degrees.

대상: one neatly coiled thick natural hemp rope bundle lying flat, stacked broad circular loops with a single short loose end resting beside the coil, no extra ties or objects
방향: Rope lies flat. Front has loose end pointing toward camera; right side loose end points viewer left; rear loose end points away.

방향: Skewer held vertically in all views, pink top cream middle green bottom, bamboo handle below. Rotate around vertical shaft.

대상: one small traditional Japanese wooden box bellows, rectangular stout wooden box, a single sliding wooden plunger handle projecting from one short end, short dark iron air nozzle on one long side near base, no fire or furnace
방향: Front is long box wall with air nozzle, rear plain long wall, right side the short end with sliding handle.

대상: one small handleless Japanese yunomi tea cup, muted sage green glazed ceramic, thick rounded lip, gently tapering body and low unglazed ochre foot ring, empty interior, no saucer or writing
방향: Cup upright. Front is the designated ceramic face; rotate around vertical center for side and rear; preserve rim and foot.
